description: This file contains shell script functions designed to prepare and update UBI devices for OpenWrt installation on Buffalo hardware. It includes functions to remove and create UBI volumes, attach to UBI devices, and update firmware hash volumes.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes before OpenWrt installation.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Recreates small UBI volumes and updates firmware hash volumes for verification.
